services.name: Art Lessons Miami
services.desc: Finding a good art teacher in Miami sounds simple until you’re sitting in traffic on the 836, trying to get your kid across town for a 4 o’clock class. Then comes the group setting where your child gets five minutes of actual instruction and spends the rest of the time waiting. There’s a better way. We bring private, one-on-one art instruction directly to your home - all the supplies included, none of the logistics. Our mobile lesson format is exactly what it sounds like. We come to you - whether you’re in Coral Gables, Kendall, Palmetto Bay, or anywhere else across the Miami area - with everything needed for a full hour of focused, hands-on instruction. No supply runs, no drop-off
